go_anchor.root_cause_no_discovery: zeroconf resolved the fe80:: address to the lowest-index interface (the P2P-GO group, same MAC as awdl0), so _airdrop._tcp announcements left via the group, not awdl0. Evidence: error scopes 47/53 = GO ifindex (wlan0=46/52 +1) in session logs; no _airdrop PTR/SRV/TXT TX on awdl0. Fixed by passing the ifindex to Zeroconf in opendrop server.py/client.py and disabling IPv6 on the group. Reproduced and fixed in an unprivileged netns with two dummy interfaces. Not yet tried with the phone.

send_to_iphone_stall.observed: 2026-10-16 11:33: 664 MB PC->iPhone accepted, 192 kB sent, then no ACK for 30 s; 'Upload stalled'. iPhone->PC 1.5 MB in 3 s just before.
send_to_iphone_stall.cause: With -F OWL sends unicast frames NOACK (no radio retries) unless -A; phone on ch 6 only 2-5 of 16 slots; TCP exponential backoff; 30 s stall limit. Read from session log (TCP frame counts per 10 s) and OWL src/tx.c.
send_to_iphone_stall.emulator_evidence: tests/awdl_link_emulator.py, 2 MB: 2/16 slots 0% loss 114 kB/s, 15% loss 26 kB/s, 30% loss stalled; 5/16 slots 0% 277 kB/s. TCP tuning +0-35%.
send_to_iphone_stall.fix: radio_ack setting on by default (--fixed-ack -> OWL -A, 15 hardware tries on MT7922); sender TCP thin linear timeouts + RTO max 2 s; 90 s stall limit; TCP_INFO report in the log; >100 MB warning. Root-side files unchanged (helper stays 'ready').
send_to_iphone_stall.status: small send confirmed with the iPhone; large sends not yet verified
send_to_iphone_stall.first_real_check_after_fix: 2026-10-16 12:03, radio acknowledgements on: a 62 KB image sent to the iPhone completed; 1.5 MB received from the iPhone in 3.3 s (same as before, so receiving is not slowed down). A multi-megabyte send has NOT been tried yet.
